interface.title: GP Screen Failure Analysis (GP Screen Analysis – Gravel Pack Failure Investigation)
interface.field: Petroleum / completion engineering. Failure analysis of gravel-pack sand-control screens using computer vision on inspection photos.
interface.stage_of_work: Post-processing review and reporting. The classical-CV batch pipeline has already run; the dashboard is for checking the results, human review of low-confidence detections, unit calibration, grouping by well and exporting the inspection record.
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit dashboard where an engineer reviews automatically detected and classified screen failures (erosion holes, corrosion pitting, plugging, mechanical damage) on inspection photos, ticks off low-confidence detections, calibrates scale, compares screens by well, and downloads CSV and PDF reports.

data.note: The pre-populated database has 9 sample screen photos (Picture 1–8.jpg, Picture_7.png) with 82 detections, 20 of them flagged for review. Overlays and PDF reports were generated at install (timestamp 2026-11-02T07:38). No test files were uploaded. The UI has no upload or re-run control, and the Reports sidebar says PDFs are produced by running scripts/batch_report.py.
